ops.title: Deploying the sweep winner: qwen3.5-9b needs an mlx-lm LoRA counterpart or a hosted-serving decision
ops.description: cc-steer's 3-arm base sweep (2026-07-18, uniform Tinker-frame instrument, identical E8 recipe) ranked qwen3.5-9b first: sentinel AUC 0.9371 vs the deployed qwen3-8b's 0.9301 (+0.0070) and 4B's 0.9262. The deployed watcher stays on 8B for now (local, free inference). Deploying the 9B upside needs one of: (a) an mlx-lm LoRA counterpart for Qwen3.5-9B (then cc-steer's normal retrain/promotion confirms under the served-MLX gate), or (b) a hosted-serving decision — the in-flight TinkerBackend.sample + sampler_path work in Unreleased is exactly the needed primitive, at $0.44/$1.33 per Mtok vs free local 8B. Full results: cc-steer ledger note 7684771. Operator's call on the cost/quality tradeoff.

ops.text: either qwen3.5-9b gains serves_locally=True with a real mlx-lm LoRA counterpart, or a hosted-watcher serving decision is recorded (TinkerBackend.sample is the primitive)
